```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/Recommendations/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/opendata-commitment-eligibility.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/Recommendations/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/opendata-commitment-eligibility.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint PowerShell
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v4
        with:
          pwsh-version: '7.4.x'

      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path './src' -Recurse -Settings './.ps-rule/RuleSuppression.psd1' -Verbose

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v4
        with:
          pwsh-version: '7.4.x'

      - name: Install Pester
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser -MinimumVersion 5.3.0

      - name: Install FinOps Toolkit Module
        run: |
          # Assuming the module is built or available locally for testing
          # If there is a build step, it would go here.
          # For now, we assume the module structure is ready for import.
          $modulePath = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'src'
          if (Test-Path $modulePath) {
            Write-Host "Module path exists: $modulePath"
          }

      - name: Run Pester Tests
        run: |
          $pesterConfig = New-PesterConfiguration
          $pesterConfig.Run.Path = './tests'
          $pesterConfig.Run.PassThru = $true
          $pesterConfig.Output.Verbosity = 'Detailed'
          $pesterConfig.TestResult.Enabled = $true
          $pesterConfig.TestResult.OutputPath = './test-results.xml'
          
          Invoke-Pester -Configuration $pesterConfig

      - name: Publish Test Results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: ./test-results.xml

  manual-deployment-check:
    name: Manual Deployment Verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, unit-tests]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v4
        with:
          pwsh-version: '7.4.x'

      - name: Verify Module Structure
        run: |
          # Check if the Recommendations module exists
          $recsPath = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/Recommendations'
          if (Test-Path $recsPath) {
            Write-Host "Recommendations module found."
          } else {
            Write-Error "Recommendations module not found at $recsPath"
            exit 1
          }

          # Check for ARG-based ingestion scripts if applicable
          $argScripts = Get-ChildItem -Path $recsPath -Filter '*.ps1' -Recurse
          Write-Host "Found $($argScripts.Count) PowerShell scripts in Recommendations module."

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: '✅ Lint and Unit Tests passed. Ready for manual deployment verification.'
            })
```
